title: Cyrus and the Autopsy
author: Freya Amberdale
blurb: Yara Joubert, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
